rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality from a single somewhat soft-focus image and introduces a likely stage-label discrepancy discussion without firm image support.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, diagnosis, semen data, endometrium, cycle history, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and well structured, with conclusions mostly supported by the case data; only minor issue is somewhat optimistic precision in morphology-based prognosis from limited imaging.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including support for single embryo transfer and avoidance of unsupported add-ons; minor deviation is the somewhat casual reinterpretation of Gardner stage terminology.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, lifestyle optimization, and escalation only after repeated failures, though some recommendations remain general rather than protocol-specific.
